votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Curtis to approve the ordinance changing the zone from R-1-10 to R-1-8 on approximately 35.65 acres located approximately 1,200 feet southwest of Gap Canyon Parkway to be known as Divario Planning Area 4. Mayor Pro Tem Hughes asked the Council what their concerns are. Councilmember McArthur commented he is concerned that the developer can choose between R-1-10 and R-1-8; however, if there is so much density in this area. If a unit count is not required on this project, he would like to see something less dense. Councilmember Larkin, agreed. Mr. Boles stated the density is less than four units per acre which complies with the Divario Master Plan. City Manager Adam Lenhard explained, based on the approved Divario Master Plan and the approved planning areas, the proposal would comply with what has already been approved.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
